description: Frame-rate floor workloads, run by tools/quality/frame_floor.py: a scripted route through a map that a player would take, judged frame by frame between the script's floor_begin and floor_end frame marks. The run stops at the first frame below floor_fps; a completed route must also reach the 1% and 0.1% low targets (fps from the mean of the slowest 1% / 0.1% of frame intervals). User direction 2026-09-30: sp_a2_laser_intro_relit is the performance fixture, with a steady 30-60 fps minimum. Superseded 2026-10-01 by the user: 120 FPS minimum, High, 1920x1080 on the current Radeon 8060S desktop. Numeric limits and the product High profile are referenced through render_budget_row; the former 30/60 FPS targets are historical. The route alone does not certify complete image/workload coverage.
